name: Somatic Reset
description: Somatic nervous-system reset to release tension in the rider's body and improve horse–rider harmony.
instructions: Ensure your horse is in a calm, low-demand context (halt or easy walk).

Follow this somatic focus: Take a deep breath and center yourself. Stay with rhythm. Notice what's working. Keep it easy. Inhale 4, exhale 6 — 6–8 cycles. Name 3 things you see; light bilateral taps for 60–90s..  End with a calm breath, a soft hand, and note one small win before moving on.
Continue for the suggested duration, watching for softening or release in both your body and your horse.
evidence_base: Somatic experiencing, polyvagal theory, and body-based emotion regulation strategies.
